remarks: Freshly painted and full of charm. 2 bedroom prewar walkup with high ceilings, arched doorways and hardwood floors. Lovely view of the courtyard and tons of natural light as it faces south west. Bathroom and kitchen have been renovated. Gas stove, and dishwasher. Cant beat the location-walk to Scalzi Park, shopping and all that downtown Stamford has to offer. See it today!
